description_en:
Meet your new favorite mug: elegant a initial inside a hand-drawn laurel wreath rendered in a warm metallic-gold tone and printed on both sides, so lefties and righties both see the art. The 11 oz ceramic body has a glossy white exterior with your choice of interior color, and the print is baked for long-lasting color. Dishwasher and microwave safe. Packed securely for safe delivery.

Perfect for the person whose name you already know — understated, personal, and always in style.
